## Architecture

### Recommendation
A React context provider plus a useShortcut hook registers palette shortcuts declaratively.

### Alternatives considered
- Global event listener — rejected: leaks handlers and is hard to scope per view.
- analogues: [{ path: src/admin/shell.tsx, why_relevant: admin shell mount point }, { path: src/admin/commands.ts, why_relevant: existing command registry }]
- Nothing in scope overrides the advisor recommendation.

Reason in prose if you like, then return your ONE JSON deliverable.
